parameters.query: INSERT INTO messages(platform,page_id,customer_platform_id,platform_message_id,lead_source,message_type,text,attachments,raw_event,conversation_link,processed,created_at) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8::jsonb,$9::jsonb,$10,FALSE,$11::timestamptz) ON CONFLICT(platform_message_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING id,platform_message_id;

INSERT INTO leads(platform,page_id,customer_platform_id,quote_code,lead_source,product,customer_name,phone,email,company,customer_type,quantity,need,lead_status,quotation_status,assigned_employee,last_contact_at,next_contact_at,employee_note,conversation_link,lead_created_at,updated_at,db_updated_at,sync_status) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,NULL,$4,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,'Chưa xác định',NULL,NULL,'NEW','CHƯA BÁO GIÁ',NULL,$5::timestamptz,NULL,NULL,$6,$5::timestamptz,NOW(),NOW(),'PENDING') ON CONFLICT(platform,page_id,customer_platform_id) DO UPDATE SET lead_source=COALESCE(leads.lead_source,EXCLUDED.lead_source),last_contact_at=CASE WHEN leads.last_contact_at IS NULL THEN EXCLUDED.last_contact_at WHEN EXCLUDED.last_contact_at>leads.last_contact_at THEN EXCLUDED.last_contact_at ELSE leads.last_contact_at END,conversation_link=COALESCE(leads.conversation_link,EXCLUDED.conversation_link),updated_at=NOW(),db_updated_at=NOW(),sync_status='PENDING' RETURNING id,platform,page_id,customer_platform_id,lead_status,quotation_status,last_contact_at;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $('Normalize Meta Message').item.json.platform, $('Normalize Meta Message').item.json.page_id, $('Normalize Meta Message').item.json.customer_platform_id, $('Normalize Meta Message').item.json.lead_source, $('Normalize Meta Message').item.json.event_timestamp, $('Normalize Meta Message').item.json.conversation_link ] }}

parameters.query: WITH p AS (SELECT DISTINCT platform,page_id,customer_platform_id FROM messages WHERE processed=FALSE) SELECT p.platform,p.page_id,p.customer_platform_id,COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(msg ORDER BY msg.created_at) FROM (SELECT m2.text,m2.message_type,m2.created_at,m2.conversation_link FROM messages m2 WHERE m2.platform=p.platform AND m2.page_id=p.page_id AND m2.customer_platform_id=p.customer_platform_id ORDER BY m2.created_at DESC LIMIT 50) msg),'[]'::json) AS messages,(SELECT MAX(m3.created_at) FROM messages m3 WHERE m3.platform=p.platform AND m3.page_id=p.page_id AND m3.customer_platform_id=p.customer_platform_id) AS latest_message_at,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages m4 WHERE m4.platform=p.platform AND m4.page_id=p.page_id AND m4.customer_platform_id=p.customer_platform_id AND m4.processed=FALSE) AS pending_count,COALESCE(to_jsonb(l),'{}'::jsonb) AS old_lead FROM p LEFT JOIN leads l ON l.platform=p.platform AND l.page_id=p.page_id AND l.customer_platform_id=p.customer_platform_id ORDER BY p.platform,p.page_id,p.customer_platform_id;

UPDATE leads SET quote_code=CASE WHEN leads.quote_code IS NULL AND $12<>'CHƯA BÁO GIÁ' THEN 'BG-'||TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE,'YYYYMMDD')||'-'||LPAD(NEXTVAL('quote_code_seq')::TEXT,6,'0') ELSE leads.quote_code END,lead_source=COALESCE($4,leads.lead_source),product=COALESCE($5,leads.product),customer_name=COALESCE($6,leads.customer_name),phone=COALESCE($7,leads.phone),email=COALESCE($8,leads.email),company=COALESCE($9,leads.company),customer_type=$10,quantity=COALESCE($11,leads.quantity),need=COALESCE($13,leads.need),lead_status=$14,quotation_status=$12,assigned_employee=leads.assigned_employee,last_contact_at=COALESCE($15::timestamptz,leads.last_contact_at),next_contact_at=leads.next_contact_at,employee_note=leads.employee_note,conversation_link=COALESCE($16,leads.conversation_link),lead_created_at=leads.lead_created_at,updated_at=NOW(),db_updated_at=NOW(),sync_status='PENDING',request_quote=$17,extraction_confidence=$18 WHERE platform=$1 AND page_id=$2 AND customer_platform_id=$3 RETURNING platform,page_id,customer_platform_id,quote_code,lead_source,product,customer_name,phone,email,company,customer_type,quantity,need,lead_status,quotation_status,assigned_employee,last_contact_at,next_contact_at,employee_note,conversation_link,lead_created_at,updated_at,db_updated_at,sync_status,request_quote,extraction_confidence;

WITH marked AS (UPDATE messages SET processed=TRUE,processed_at=NOW() WHERE platform=$1 AND page_id=$2 AND customer_platform_id=$3 AND processed=FALSE RETURNING id) SELECT l.platform,l.page_id,l.customer_platform_id,l.quote_code,l.lead_source,l.product,l.customer_name,l.phone,l.email,l.company,l.customer_type,l.quantity,l.need,l.lead_status,l.quotation_status,l.assigned_employee,l.last_contact_at,l.next_contact_at,l.employee_note,l.conversation_link,l.lead_created_at,l.updated_at,l.db_updated_at,l.sync_status FROM leads l WHERE l.platform=$1 AND l.page_id=$2 AND l.customer_platform_id=$3;
